hero.description: NexSift is a knowledge aggregator that gets straight to the point. It filters, verifies and contextualizes what matters across AI, cloud, development and tech careers, with every signal traceable to its official source.

latest.title: What deserves your attention now
latest.description: Not a news portal. A short selection of signals with enough context and a traceable source.

topics.title: Six areas, one radar
topics.description: Coverage is broad. Selection stays focused on signals with real technical or professional impact.

process.title: Curation before publication
process.description: AI helps research, organize and review. Published content must stay traceable to its sources.

trust.title: AI assisted. Sources visible.
trust.description: Each analysis gets straight to the point: what happened, what changed and why it matters. NexSift does not replace the original source; it points to the material that supports the content and separates facts from interpretation.

about.title: A technical filter, not another infinite feed
about.body: NexSift exists to reduce the cost of keeping up with technology. Instead of reproducing everything that gets published, it prioritizes signals with real impact for people who build software, work with cloud or follow the evolution of AI.
